sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Agent Skills is a collection of engineering skills by Addy Osmani that teaches AI coding agents to work like senior engineers. It covers the whole cycle from writing a spec to planning, building, testing, reviewing and shipping.
sixtySeconds.problem: Coding agents skip steps senior engineers take for granted, like writing a spec, building in small slices, testing and reviewing before merge. These skills package those workflows and quality gates so agents follow them every time.
whoFor: Developers using Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Copilot
Teams that want consistent agent quality gates
Frontend developers who want performance and accessibility audits
People new to structured engineering workflows
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a well-organised set of lifecycle skills from a respected engineer, with simple commands like /spec and /ship. If you only want one workflow, you can install single skills.
requirements: A supported coding agent (70+ via the skills CLI)

overview: The collection maps to six phases: define, plan, build, verify, review and ship. Ten slash commands drive them: /spec, /plan, /build, /test, /constraints, /review, /webperf, /a11y, /code-simplify and /ship. Each command activates the right skills automatically.

Skills also trigger on their own based on what you're doing, for example API design or UI work. /build auto generates the plan and implements every task in one approved pass, removing the manual steps between tasks but not the verification.

You can install all 26 skills with the open skills CLI into more than 70 agents, or pick individual ones such as code review, interview-me or test-driven development. In Claude Code they install as a plugin; where a built-in command shares a name, such as /review, use /agent-skills:review.

troubleshooting.problem: Claude Code marketplace install fails with SSH errors
troubleshooting.solution: Use the HTTPS URL: /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills.git, or run git config --global url."https://github.com/".insteadOf git@github.com:

troubleshooting.problem: A single installed skill can't find its checklist
troubleshooting.solution: Per-skill installs skip the shared references folder. Install the whole repo or copy the checklist into the skill's references directory.
Use the namespaced /agent-skills:review in Claude Code.
